name: Cache Metrics
description: Logs and measures cache performance (hit/miss rates) over time.
project_description:
Logs all cache tag invalidations 
 Sends cache tag invalidations to New Relic as Custom Events. Visualize and Analyze via New Relic Insights (see attached bar chart showing invalidation by tag), 
 Sends cache hits/misses to New Relic as Custom Events. See the table in the image thats attached to this page. 
 
 New Relic may be swapped for a different provider. See README.md for much more information about this module.
